Concurrent crawl respects max_depth limit

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"max_concurrent\":3,\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawl(engine: engineObj, url: url)
print(result)
```
